site.math.description: Game-style math for elementary, middle and high school students. 3-10 minute quests take you from concepts to problem solving, and hints help you solve on your own.
site.english.description: Game-style English for elementary, middle and high school students. Learn words, grammar and sentence building through short quests.
site.korean.name: Korean
site.korean.tagline: Today's quest: a round of Korean!
site.korean.description: From reading Hangul to everyday conversation. Read, listen to and learn Korean in short quests. Explanations appear in the language you choose.
landing.eyebrow: Don't come to study. Come for a quest.
landing.how1.title: Short quests
landing.how1.body: 3-10 minutes at a time. Concept → example → problems → challenge, so you build up small wins.
landing.how2.title: Solve it yourself with hints
landing.how2.body: It's okay to get it wrong. A small hint, a detailed hint, then the steps help you until you understand.
landing.how3.title: See yourself grow
landing.how3.body: XP, levels, streaks and your skill map show how much you grew today.
landing.privacy: We don't ask for your real name, phone number or school. A nickname and your grade are all we need.
